Previous releases only read ssh_key_pairs on its own by public_key and never join it to another table
Joined credential queries qualify purpose, and single-table lookups use it to keep AI credentials separate from default credentials.
Existing credential queries join only projects and credential preference tables, which have no expires_at column, and select qualified credential columns.

FK deliberately named after the referenced ai_organization_provider_credential primary key, matching the existing project_ai_settings pin column. The previous release never selects this column and has no query joining ai_agent with the credential tables, so no existing query becomes ambiguous during a rolling deploy.
